test_title: SSC Selection Post 2025 (Matriculation Level) Official Paper (Held On: 01 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Choose the option that will replace the error highlighted in bold.**
The spokesperson said the company launches** its new product two months ago.
solution:
The correct answer is '**Launched**'.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
__
 
• The sentence mentions an action that occurred two months ago, which clearly indicates that the past tense is required.
 
• The verb "**Launched**" is the simple past tense form of the verb "**Launch**."
 
• **Option 1 ("Has launched")** is incorrect because the present perfect tense ("has launched") is used for actions that have relevance to the present, which is not the case here.
 
• **Option 2 ("Had launched")** is incorrect because the past perfect tense ("had launched") is used to describe an action completed before another action in the past, which is not applicable here.
 
• **Option 4 ("Is launching")** is incorrect because the present continuous tense ("is launching") is used for ongoing actions, not past actions.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.
 
**Complete Sentence:** *"The spokesperson said the company **launched**__ its new product two months ago."*
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "Has launched"** is incorrect because the present perfect tense is not suitable for a specific time in the past ("two months ago").
 
• **Option 2: "Had launched"** is incorrect because the past perfect tense is only used when there is another past reference point.
 
• **Option 4: "Is launching"** is incorrect because it implies an action happening right now, which contradicts the past time frame mentioned.
